name: jig-orchestration
description: Coordinate scoped Herdr tasks across machines through tracker claims, review, GitHub PRs, and acceptance.

interface.longDescription: Codex coordination for a named task set or epic using registered Herdr endpoints, Beads Rust or Beadroll, and GitHub. Persists execution slots, work controls, action identities, and delivery evidence. Requires separately installed jig-review skills for review drivers and Herdr on participating machines; startup checks capabilities without installing or upgrading dependencies.
defaultPrompt: Use Herdr to deliver this task batch through GitHub PRs
